name: Exodia Draw-Stall
note: Fringe by design: alternate-win 'assemble the 5 pieces' deck built around the Royal Magical Library draw engine, distinct from src/decks/exodia-stall.json — docs/decks-archetypes.md §10. Names validated against cards.cdb.
manual:
**Game plan:** the two-part Exodia recipe — draw as hard as possible while stalling behind defensive cards until all five Forbidden One pieces are in hand. Fringe by design: this wins by an alternate condition, not fair beatdown.

**Key cards / engine:** Royal Magical Library draw engine; cost-free/refilling draw spells; tutors (Sangan/Witch) for the last pieces; stall walls.

**How to pilot / combo lines:**
- **`Royal Magical Library` is the free-draw engine.** Each time a Spell is activated, place a Spell Counter (max 3); remove 3 counters to draw 1 card. This deck fires a wall of spells, so the Library turns three of them into an extra card each cycle — with all three copies out the deck digs alarmingly fast. ⚠ unverified line (common knowledge, not a fetched primer).
- **Cost-free / refilling draw.** `Pot of Greed` (+1), `Graceful Charity` (+3, discard 2 — never pitch a piece), `Upstart Goblin` (draw 1, opponent gains 1000 LP — thins the deck for free), `Magical Mallet` (shuffle your hand back and redraw the same number — reshuffle dead cards, and it charges the Library too), `Reload`/`Card Destruction` refresh a bricked hand. Never discard an Exodia piece to these — pitch stall or duplicate draw spells instead.
- **Tutors for the last mile:** `Sangan` (search a ≤1500-ATK monster on death) and `Witch of the Black Forest` (search a ≤1500-DEF monster on death) find the final limb. `Gold Sarcophagus` banishes a card from Deck face-up and adds it to hand after 2 Standby Phases — bank a piece you'll draw into. `Legacy of Yata-Garasu`/`Jar of Greed`/`Good Goblin Housekeeping` are trap-speed draws that dig on the opponent's turn without feeding the Library.
- **The stall wall buys the turns.** `Swords of Revealing Light` (3 turns no attacks), `Level Limit - Area B` (flips all Level-4+ monsters to Defense), `Messenger of Peace` (1500+ ATK monsters can't attack), `Gravity Bind` (Level-4+ can't attack) lock the board; `Marshmallon` (indestructible by battle) and `Spirit Reaper` are untouchable walls; `Waboku`/`Threatening Roar` stop a Battle Phase outright. `Emergency Provisions` dumps now-dead stall spells for LP if you're racing a burn clock.
- **Sequencing:** stall turn 1, then chain draw spells through a Library to bank extra draws; hold tutors as your safety net for the fifth piece; win at instant clarity once all five pieces are in hand.

**Weaknesses:** it does nothing to the opponent's board except stall, so aggressive decks that punch through the walls (or hand disruption / deck-out effects) beat it; a bad draw of all stall and no engine (or vice versa) bricks; genuinely fringe — include for variety, not for a consistent win rate.
